notes.title: Prologue Released - PLAY FOR FREE
notes.content:
[h1][b]HELLO OFFICERS![/b] 👮‍♀️👮‍♂️[/h1]

[h2]🚨[b]Police Shootout: Prologue is NOW on Steam! [/b]🚨[/h2]
[h2]You can download it totally for [b]free[/b]! Just click the link below 👇[/h2] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1661280/Police_Shootout_Prologue/

[h2][b]PLAY NOW[/b] 🔥[/h2]

[b]Some of you are surely wondering what a prologue is?[/b] 
So Police Shootout: Prologue is a part of the full version of the game and is completely free. You will get to know many new interesting features, especialy voice overs for 13 languages. The most important is that prologue allows you to get into the world of Police Shootout so you will be fully ready before the final product release! We count on your feedback and suggestions for the game. 😊

Regards, 
Police Shootout Team

notes.title: Police Shootout DEVLOG #14
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back to our Police Shootout devlogs![/h2]

Before we start, if you haven't played the demo yet, it's time to do it - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/][b]PLAY NOW
[/b][/url]

Life is unpredictable, especially if you're living a life of a police officer! 👮 
Even though you will be having a very responsible and demanding job, you won't have control over every single situation. Sometimes, the consequences or some unexpected behaviors may get worse than you expect them to be. 

Don't worry! We have a bringing-relief solution for you 😊 If something goes wrong, you can always use the possibility of restarting the mission. It will be available from the pause menu.

notes.title: Police Shootout DEVLOG #11
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back to our Police Shootout devlogs![/h2]

Before we start, if you haven't played the demo yet, it's time to do it - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/][b]PLAY NOW
[/b][/url]

As an experienced police officer, you should certainly know, that EVERY single decision matters. 👮 We are talking here about all possible scenarios that may happen in cop's everyday life - no matter how diverse the task is. One day you may prevent stealing a car and the next day you may save someone's child. You never know what may happen! 

The most important thing is that you should keep a cool head and do your job as good as you can. Why are we covering this subject? Because in today's devlog we want to show you the summary of every mission. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/2a701e9779d7ce62e7e4b428a6607b63f9fd9cbc.png[/img]

We decided to make the summary very detailed - it means that you will see every possible option available in a certain scenario. Right next to the option you can see if the task has been done by you, or on the other hand, if you have missed something. Remember that the game will always ask you if you're absolutely done in this location - to make sure you can always check the environment once again and complete the mission in 100% 😊 

On the summary you, can also see the bonuses you earned and... even the penalties if you did something wrong. 

What do you think about that feature? See you in the next devlog!

notes.title: Police Shootout DEVLOG #9
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back to our Police Shootout devlogs![/h2]

Before we start, if you haven't played the demo yet, it's time to do it - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/][b]PLAY NOW
[/b][/url]

As a police officer you need to be flexible and fast - the citizens may need you at any time of the day or night! That's why every police officer has their own car. 🚓

Today we would like to show you some sneak peeks of the car equipment. In the police car you will find a special computer and a first aid kit. 

💻 [b]Computer[/b] - it's a great way to read some reports about the current mission. What is happening? Where is it happening? Are there any injured victims? Here is all the information you need, so have a quick look before you start your mission. 

🩹[b]First aid kit[/b] - You can come to the car anytime and heal a part of injuries you got during the mission.

notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back to our Police Shootout devlogs![/h2]

Before we start, if you haven't played the demo yet, it's time to do it - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/][b]PLAY NOW

Today we would like to present the [b]mission menu[/b]. We did our best to create the most immersive menu we could, so this is the reason why it looks like a city map 🗺️

As you can see, there's also a map legend available for you and we have already implemented three options: available mission, mission accomplished and menu.

🔶 [b]Mission accomplished:[/b] You can repeat the mission you have done before. 
🟩 [b]Menu:[/b] You can go back to the main menu of the game by clicking on this sign.

notes.title: Police Shootout DEVLOG #6
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back to our Police Shootout devlogs! [/h2]

Today, we would like to present another essential part of police officer's everyday life. 

But before we start, if you haven't played the [b]demo[/b] yet, it's time to do it - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/][b]PLAY NOW[/b][/url]

As you may already know, they always need to be prepared for every eventuality and carry the most needed items with themselves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/7e6e81d3baceaaf2e9c014d01e612e53212bcfe4.png[/img]

In Police Shootout you can open the [b]inventory[/b] by pressing [b]Q[/b]. After that you will see the equipment wheel with few, very interesting options, for example - your notebook. Here you can see the statistics of a current mission and other important information and facts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/9e58496fc1407643fdcc1ad1f5b0fbef8e8b0a34.png[/img]

There is also space for other items such as: radio, handcuffs, flashlight and guns. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/429ad2fd78c2933f8af9157a6beec0aaa23c336b.png[/img]

Are you ready for more? Stay tuned for another devlogs! 😊

notes.title: Police Shootout Demo | UPDATE AND FIXES
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everybody! [/h2]

Thank you for playing our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/][b]DEMO[/b][/url] and also huge thank you for sharing all your opinions and reporting all the bugs that you have encountered. It really helped us to fix the game as soon as possible - so you can enjoy the gameplay. Today we are excited to release another patch! 

[u][b]The list of changes:[/b][/u]
- Exit outside the Supermarket map was blocked,
- the ability to get outside the conversation zone to the start of the Supermarket map, blocked
- flying visible items have been fixed, for example when we started taking them out and a conversation started,
- added some new sounds,
- Negotiation tutorial - Second negotiations are optional,
- exit from the "Shooting" tutorial has been marked,
- gifs for tutorials (Shootout and Stealth),
- the visibility of buttons on the computer screen in the car has been improved,
- we facilitated the first tutorial negotiations,
- improved "Balance of Tactical" shooting,
- increased visibility of UI elements during shooting,
- added the outline of the suspect's weapon when we are close,
- added icons indicating the type of enemy,
- linguistic errors were corrected and gaps were filled,
- added more 'life' to the training map, especially more elements and sounds
- added information about death,
- CoverPoint shield pulsing has been changed,
- the layout of shooting tutorial objects has been changed,

If you haven't played the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/][b]DEMO[/b][/url] yet, you still have a chance to do it and to share your feedback with us! :) 
Thank you! 

[url=https://discord.gg/cHCTwwvan9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout

notes.title: Police Shootout DEVLOG #5
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]

At first, it's worth mentioning that we were part of Steam Next Fest from 16th to 22nd of June! :) 

Due to this opportunity, you had a chance of playing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout][b]DEMO[/b][/url] version of Police Shootout. It was certainly a good occasion to share your feedback on the game, report bugs and of course, ask many questions! 

Our Developers would like to thank you from the bottom of their hearts. They were really amazed and shocked by your enormous concern about the game. Together with the whole team, [b]thank you[/b]! ❤️

Your's feedback gives us a big knowledge of what is right and what is wrong, what you like, and what still needs a bit of polishing. We are also aware of what needs to be fixed in order to make gameplay more enjoyable. Thank you!

-----------

On today's devlog let's focus on the [b]covers.[/b] As a smart police officer you will need to use the environment in order to succeed in your confontations.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/b3d4b866c3c872df10dbb15c6d9ca4e2d4cbd6a5.png[/img]

Dodging a bullet is very essential in this game - let's remember that we are not immortal and every single shot aimed by our opponent makes a big difference. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/1036666e6c63589d5bc96abcc0da3b106d891a11.png[/img]

We also decided to divide the cover areas into categories, to make the gameplay more immersive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/cca918fec168ce40b499219e0547cf6d5a775c93.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more! 

Thank you once again, it's such a pleasure to have such a great community :) 

[url=https://discord.gg/cHCTwwvan9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/
